      working-directory: onesa-drone
  mobile-android:
    needs: mobile
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 40
    env:
      CI: '1'
      EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY: '1'
    steps:
    - name: Verify hosted execution, visibility and included-allowance policy
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        EXPECTED_PRIVATE: ${{ github.event.repository.private }}
        PRIVATE_VALIDATION_ENABLED: ${{ vars.ONESA_PRIVATE_HOSTED_VALIDATION_ENABLED }}
      run: |
        test "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT" = github-hosted
        actual=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --jq ".private")
        test "$actual" = "$EXPECTED_PRIVATE" || { echo "Repository visibility changed"; exit 1; }
        if [ "$actual" = true ] && [ "$PRIVATE_VALIDATION_ENABLED" != true ]; then
          echo "Private hosted verification requires explicit included-allowance opt-in"
          exit 1
        fi
      working-directory: .
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
        fetch-depth: 0

      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
    - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1
      with:
        node-version: 24.22.1
        cache: npm
        cache-dependency-path: onesa-drone/frontend/drone/mobile/package-lock.json
    - name: Install locked mobile dependencies
      working-directory: onesa-drone/frontend/drone/mobile
      run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
    - name: Generate Android sources from the locked local Expo template
      run: python3 -m scripts.mobile_native_compile prepare --platform android --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/drone-native-android"
      working-directory: onesa-drone
    - name: Select the reviewed JDK and Android SDK versions
      run: |
        test -d "$JAVA_HOME_17_X64"
        echo "JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_HOME_17_X64" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        echo "$JAVA_HOME_17_X64/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
        test -x "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" 'platforms;android-37.0' 'build-tools;37.0.0' 'ndk;27.1.12297006'
        # The published API 37.0 platform needs RN's integer compileSdk alias.
        test -f "$ANDROID_HOME/platforms/android-37.0/android.jar"
        if [ ! -e "$ANDROID_HOME/platforms/android-37" ]; then
          ln -s android-37.0 "$ANDROID_HOME/platforms/android-37"
        fi
      working-directory: onesa-drone
    - name: 'Release requirement: Compile arm64 Android debug application'
      working-directory: onesa-drone/frontend/drone/mobile
      run: ./android/gradlew -p android :app:assembleDebug -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a --no-daemon --console=plain
    - name: 'Release requirement: Qualify Android native output and source proof'
      run: python3 -m scripts.mobile_native_compile qualify --platform android --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/drone-native-android"
      working-directory: onesa-drone
    - name: 'Release requirement: Retain Android native compile evidence'
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
      with:
        name: drone-mobile-android-native-compile
        path: |
          ${{ runner.temp }}/drone-native-android/compile-proof.json
          ${{ runner.temp }}/drone-native-android/OnesaDrone-arm64-debug.apk
        if-no-files-found: error
        retention-days: 7
        compression-level: 0
